name: Decorated Singleton-$aq$ Crossed-Subcube Obstructions
statement: When $U=\{u\}$, delete $\{a,q\}$ from the $(\alpha,\beta)=(1,0)$ crossed base and optionally delete $\{a,b,q\}$ and $\{a,p,q\}$ with flags $\rho,\sigma$. The result remains a learning space. Its complementary endpoints have repair sets $\{a\}\cup V$ and $\{b,u,p,q\}$, so the pendant extension is contraction-minimal nonlearning of order $2^d-2^{|V|+1}-5-\rho-\sigma$.
proof: The added missing states are hereditary below their $a$ anchor, preserving union closure, and the crossed-base accessibility proof survives. Explicit rooted-union witnesses add exactly the decorated holes. Intersecting their neighbor directions gives the displayed repair sets, which cover every coordinate.
